mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 56 degrees that feels more like 47 degrees out there today.
The latest Verona city news recap highlights several recent police calls, including traffic citations, domestic disturbances, and business assistance calls reported throughout the week.

There is plenty to do in our community. We have Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by several trivia nights and live music options starting tomorrow, plus our Main Street Trick or Treat event coming up on October 29.
In a notable report from October 25, Verona police officers responded to an intersection where they discovered a driver passed out and subsequently conducted an arrest for an O W I.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10 PM tonight, and they are serving up the delicious Pumpkin Pecan flavor of the day.
